new_resource: One explicitly declared finite later time window. This increases time resources; it does not reset the original clock or complete the original timed stage retroactively.
absolute_start_and_end: Choose and freeze in the concrete scope after engineering acceptance; this policy does not start a clock or create a window.
case_identity_packet_workbench_arm_and_r: Unchanged original four cases and baseline arm; no replacement, regeneration, seed selection or new independent start.
allowed_progression: Continue each original unfinished case using its own complete verified history, then advance in the original fixed order after the original terminal rules. Do not change the task set based on results.
accounting_domain: Same original registry and SQLite ledger; carry all original call/action counters, known charges, failures, reservations and unknown exposure.
only_old_unknown_exception: The exact original rejected HTTP400 call retains its 80000 quarantine; any new unknown model/tool completion stops the whole supplementary stage.
starting_counts_are_not_assumed: Concrete scope and each next-call admission must read and verify current cumulative records. Known current baseline is two transports and one applied input query, but these are not resettable counters.
historical_immutability: Keep original v15 run/call/plan, v16 correction, v17 scope/admission and existing call/action originals. Current governance progress may change only with a frozen pre-stage full snapshot and transactional before/after audit under the explicit new phase identity.
research_context: Original ordinary public packet and contract plus all own verified model responses and actually returned public observations. No private generator/evaluator, other-case transcripts, human solution hints, hidden full tables or silent context truncation.
provider_identity: Record requested model separately; supplier identity remains unverified unless actually attested.
public_resource_notice: This continues the same development investigation in one supplementary time window. The original next-model window has ended; this stage explicitly adds finite time. Original tasks, tools, complete returned history and cumulative token/action limits are unchanged. Current remaining resources are reported from the verified ledger.
terminal_policy: Keep every legal final, abstention, invalid final, budget stop, unknown and not_started case in its original descriptive denominator. If the one supplementary stage expires incomplete, retain that result; do not automatically reopen it.

self_check.assessment: Existing information is an input-inspection response; infrastructure interruption does not establish discovery ability. One declared continuation can obtain useful descriptive evidence while retaining original time failure and charges.
self_check.next_step: Accept only the minimal new governance and GUI changes, verify exact concrete scope and unique worker control, then run under the unchanged cumulative resource caps. Preserve actual final quality for independent review.
self_check.falsifiers: Any mismatch in old records, missing own context, duplicate execution, changed monetary/action caps, implicit time extension, private hints, unknown completion or unprovable phase/source binding blocks admission.
